biography: Tomas occupies a thoughtful and understated niche within the storied annals of the Hector Trophée, bringing his refined golfing talents from the immaculate fairways of Espoo Ringside Golf to the esteemed pair competition across three distinct editions. Away from the manicured greens of the tournament, this dedicated gentleman is known among his companions for a wonderfully calm and measured disposition, often approaching life with the serene patience of a master chess player who prefers to evaluate every possible outcome before making a single move.

Although Tomas has officially concluded his active chapters within the tournament and is now considered retired from further Hector engagements, his legacy remains firmly preserved in the tournament archives. While victories of the coveted Hector Trophée and the individual acclaim of the Victor Trophy ultimately remained outside his personal collection across his three tournament appearances, his dignified presence and unwavering sportsmanship left an enduring impression on everyone fortunate enough to share the fairways with him.
